study_design: functional dissection with CRISPR-Cas9 editing in primary human adipocytes
conclusion: Identifies rs1421085 T-to-C as the causal variant in the FTO obesity locus: it disrupts a conserved ARID5B repressor motif, derepresses a preadipocyte enhancer, doubles IRX3 and IRX5 expression, and shifts differentiation from energy-dissipating beige adipocytes to energy-storing white adipocytes.
